title: Corporate Benefits Administrator
company: Titan Wealth Holdings Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Titan Wealth is a fast-growing wealth management business, both in the UK and internationally. It has evolved a fairer, more efficient and effective business model, structured to deliver leading advice-led wealth management services, giving financial advisers and their clients the best opportunity to fulfil their dreams and ambitions.

We provide a dynamic work environment full of opportunity, one where both individual and team initiative and contribution is encouraged, so that together we can deliver better outcomes for our clients over the long term.

We're looking for a Corporate Benefits Administrator to join our growing Corporate Benefits team at Titan Wealth. This is a fantastic opportunity to build your career within a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you'll support the delivery of high-quality Group Risk and Healthcare solutions.

You'll work closely with Consultants, clients and insurers to ensure a seamless service-playing a key role in managing client queries, supporting renewals and maintaining accurate scheme data.

As part of our Client Support team, you'll be responsible for supporting a portfolio of clients across Group Risk and Healthcare schemes, ensuring a high standard of service and accuracy at all times.

Responsibilities
- Act as a key point of contact for clients, handling day-to-day queries in a professional and timely manner
- Support the renewal process, including:
- Collecting and validating membership data
- Liaising with insurers for quotations
- Preparing draft recommendation reports
- Produce and issue annual accounts accurately and within agreed timescales
- Support Group Risk claims and underwriting processes, liaising with insurers and stakeholders
- Monitor outstanding payments and proactively follow up with clients
- Assist with invoicing, ensuring accuracy and timely processing
- Manage mid-term adjustments, including joiners and leavers across schemes
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across internal systems
- Build strong relationships with clients, consultants and insurers
- Prioritise workload effectively to meet deadlines across multiple client requirements

What we're looking for Skills
- High attention to detail, particularly when working with complex data
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Clear and professional communication, both written and verbal
- A methodical and structured approach to problem-solving
- Strong Excel and MS Office skills, with the ability to analyse and reconcile data
- Proactive mindset with a sense of ownership and accountability
- A collaborative team player who supports wider business goals

Experience

Essential:
- Experience in an administration or client support role
- Experience working to deadlines/SLA-driven environments
- Strong stakeholder management skills (internal and external)
- Experience maintaining accurate records and ensuring data integrity
- Ability to prioritise and manage workload effectively
- Awareness of regulatory principles (e.g. Treating Customers Fairly / Consumer Duty)

Desirable:
- Experience within financial services or insurance
- Exposure to employee benefits or group risk administration
- Knowledge of:
- Group Income Protection (GIP)
- Group Life Assurance (GLA)
- Private Medical Insurance (PMI)
- Understanding of workplace pensions administration
- Experience supporting renewal processes

Qualifications
- Relevant qualifications are desirable but not essential
- Working towards or holding a CII qualification would be advantageous

Our employees are talented people, distinguished by excellence. You will be able to demonstrate a willingness to embrace the Company values of:

Creativity - we recognise we need new ways of thinking, learning and doing to both improve our own productivity and efficiency as well as to help us stay ahead of competitors.

Commitment - we are team with the willingness to put time, effort and energy into driving change in the organisation, going the extra mile.

Collaboration - we need teamwork amongst ourselves and with partners to generate more innovative, efficient and effective solutions and thereby a greater sense of achievement.

Terms
- Competitive salary
- Attractive Employee Pension Scheme (7.5% employer & minimum 3% employee)
- 25 days Annual Leave + public holidays
- Buy and sell holidays up to 5 days
- Office Christmas close (3-days)
- A range of benefits which includes private medical insurance, Group life insurance, and income protection insurance.
- Hybrid working
- Further education and training support
- Discretionary performance related bonus
- Confidential Employee Assistance Programme
- 2 days per year for voluntary work
- And lots of flexible benefits to choose from!

The Titan Wealth Group is firmly committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment for everyone who works with us, regardless of their race, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, physical ability or disability, or political affiliation. We believe that having a diverse team allows us to create the best possible outcomes for our clients and team members. We strive to provide equal opportunities in all aspects of the workplace with respect to recruitment and career advancement, pay and benefits, training and development opportunities and other job-related activities.

title: Operations Business Support Coordinator
description:
Operations Support & Compliance Officer

Location: Near Royston, Hertfordshire
Salary: £28,000 to £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Hours: 25 to 30 hours per week, with full-time applications also considered
Contract: Permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid, with Mondays and Fridays working from home
Holiday: 28 days' annual leave plus a Christmas shutdown, in addition to your holiday allowance
Driving requirement: Due to the office location, you will need your own transport

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an experienced and highly organised Operations Support & Compliance Officer to join a well-established professional services organisation based near Royston.

This is a varied and responsible position that combines compliance, operational support, associate onboarding, information security administration, Health & Safety coordination and general office support.

You will work closely with internal teams, external associates and other stakeholders, helping to ensure that regulatory, operational and information security requirements are consistently maintained.

The organisation is open to candidates looking for 25 to 30 hours per week, as well as those seeking a full-time opportunity, making this an excellent option for someone looking for a role with flexibility. ?

Key Responsibilities

Compliance and HR Administration
- Supporting with HR compliance requirements for employees and external associates
- Maintaining accurate records and tracking mandatory documentation
- Handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion
- Responding to day-to-day compliance queries
- Ensuring actions, records and documentation are completed accurately and within agreed timescales

Associate Recruitment and Onboarding
- Supporting recruitment administration, including coordinating interviews, managing initial applications and assessments, and preparing recruitment information
- Coordinating onboarding processes, including documentation, inductions, contracts, BPSS checks and security clearance administration
- Carrying out periodic compliance reviews and collating quality, skills and feedback information
- Supporting quality assurance and supervision processes
- Helping to coordinate associate communications, networking activities, newsletters and online resources
- Supporting the analysis of capacity, skills availability, utilisation and future recruitment requirements
- Coordinating offboarding processes, including account closures and data clean-up in line with retention requirements

Information Security
- Acting as a first point of contact for information security queries from internal colleagues and external associates
- Monitoring information security inboxes and ensuring enquiries or actions are directed appropriately
- Supporting the administration and maintenance of the Information Security Management System
- Tracking security-related actions and ensuring they are updated accurately
- Following up with stakeholders to obtain information and progress outstanding tasks
- Promoting the importance of effective information security and compliance throughout the organisation
- Supporting internal ISO audits, compliance reviews and action tracking
- Providing administrative cover for designated information security activities when required

Health & Safety and Office Support
- Maintaining Health & Safety records
- Coordinating workplace inspections
- Tracking mandatory training
- Supporting risk assessment reviews
- Assisting with accident and incident reporting
- Monitoring and ordering office supplies
- Providing general administrative support across the organisation
- Coordinating meetings, maintaining governance records and assisting with organisational projects

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience within an administration, operations, compliance or coordination role
- Excellent attention to detail and a highly organised approach
- The ability to manage several priorities and meet deadlines
- A high level of integrity, discretion and professionalism
- Experience of handling confidential or sensitive information
- Strong Microsoft 365 skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Confidence communicating with colleagues, external associates and other stakeholders
- The ability to work independently while contributing to a wider team

Previous experience in any of the following would be advantageous, although not essential:
- Working within an ISO 27001 environment
- Information security or compliance administration
- BPSS checks or security clearance administration
- Health & Safety support
- Risk identification and mitigation
- Working with associates, contractors or freelancers

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 to £30,000, depending on experience
- 28 days' annual leave
- An additional Christmas shutdown, which does not come out of your holiday allowance
- Hybrid working, with Mondays and Fridays from home
- Flexibility to consider both reduced hours and full-time applications
- A permanent position within an established professional services organisation
- A varied role with genuine involvement across operations, compliance, information security and people processes
- The opportunity to develop broader experience within a supportive and professional working environment

Additional Information

The office is based in a rural location near Royston. Due to limited public transport and the location of the office, applicants will need to have a driving licence and access to their own vehicle.

If you are a thorough, dependable and highly organised individual who enjoys taking ownership, supporting others and keeping important processes on track, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today by submitting your CV, or contact our recruitment team for a confidential discussion about the role.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
We are currently recruiting for an exciting opportunity as an Operations Co-Ordinator to join a growing and dynamic team based in Hertfordshire. This role offers the chance to be at the centre of a thriving business, supporting the full lifecycle of order fulfilment, from supplier coordination to client communication and logistics management. The client is renowned for delivering comprehensive end-to-end procurement, supply chain management, logistics and financial solutions. The client boasts a global network, with offices in Europe, America, and Asia.

You will work closely with internal departments and external partners to ensure seamless delivery of goods and services, troubleshoot issues, and keep everything moving swiftly and efficiently. The successful candidate will drive negotiations with third-party service providers that assist with completing a job to the best possible standards. This role is perfect for someone detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to grow within a busy operations environment.

You will be responsible for raising purchase orders through the company's processes, initiating the supply chain by placing orders with suppliers, and ensuring timely order processing. A key part of the role includes investigating and resolving discrepancies raised by clients, suppliers, or internal teams, as well as escalating any ongoing issues to senior management for a swift resolution. This is a role where you will be required to go above and beyond for your clients, so a certain level of professionalism and a customer service mindset will be paramount.

This is an office-based position that is situated in Hertfordshire. Due to the location of the office, this role would be commutable from Hemel Hempstead, Watford, Amersham, St Albans, Beaconsfield, Uxbridge, Barnet, High Wycombe, Borehamwood & Welwyn Garden City. The role offers a generous salary, as well as a fantastic bonus scheme, that can be achieved after passing a probationary period.

title: Claims Handler
description:
We are working with a leading specialist firm to find three organised and detail-driven Claims Handlers to join their growing team. This is an office based opportunity offering a salary of £25,000 plus a discretionary bonus of up to 5% (subject to eligibility).

The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced, process-focused environment and delivering outstanding service to clients.

You'll be responsible for managing a high volume of claims with accuracy, professionalism and a consistently strong customer-service approach. If you thrive on structure, enjoy problem-solving, and take pride in well-maintained records and compliant processes, this role offers a strong platform for development within a respected legal and claims environment.

The Role
You will support the smooth and efficient processing of claims from start to finish, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and clear communication with all stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle and process a high volume of claims daily, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution.
- Review, evaluate and determine the validity of claims in line with company policies.
- Provide clear, courteous and timely responses to clients and internal teams.
- Maintain accurate documentation and organised digital records for all claims handled.
- Ensure full adherence to internal policies, regulatory standards and industry guidelines.
- Liaise collaboratively with colleagues across departments to support smooth workflow.
- Contribute insights to improve processes and service levels within the claims team.
- Participate in ongoing training and stay up to date with any process or system changes.

The Person
The client is seeking diligent, organised individuals who can maintain high standards while managing competing priorities. You will have:
- A Levels or an equivalent Level 3 qualification (a law degree is desirable but not essential).
- Experience in a claims-handling role, ideally within bulk or high-volume claims.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple tasks professionally.
- A confident, clear and polite communication style.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Benefits
- Discretionary bonus scheme of up to 5% of salary (subject to eligibility).
- Death-in-service cover.
- Perkbox benefits package.
- Holiday allowance that increases by 1 day for every completed financial year (up to an additional 5 days).
- Supportive, team-focused working environment with structured processes and professional standards.

title: Claims Handler
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and resilient Claims Handler to join our client working in property debt collection. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of property-related financial claims, reviewing accounts, investigating discrepancies, and working to recover outstanding property debts or damages efficiently while adhering to industry regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Claim Review & Processing: Review incoming property debt claims, verify documentation, and assess the validity of the accounts or damages.
- Investigation: Gather evidence, review property agreements, and cross-reference financial records to determine the best course of action for recovery.
- Negotiation & Communication: Contact debtors, landlords, or relevant stakeholders via phone and written correspondence to negotiate repayment plans or settlements.
- Account Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all claim progress, communications, and financial transactions within the database.
- Compliance & Escalation: Ensure all recovery actions comply with legal frameworks and company guidelines, escalating complex or disputed cases to legal teams when necessary.

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in claims handling, debt collection, or the property/finance sector.
- Strong negotiation, persuasion, and conflict-resolution skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
- High level of organisation with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
- Ability to remain calm under pressure and work effectively toward performance targets.

Benefits:
- 25 days holiday plus 1 additional day for every full year of service.
- Discretionary bonus.
- On-site parking.
- Company Pension.
- Company social events.
- Death in service.
- Progression opportunities.

Despite our best efforts it is not always possible to respond to every application individually due to the high volume of responses we receive on each vacancy. Only candidates who are short listed will be contacted for this particular role and if you have not heard from us within 7 days please assume that you have not been successful. However, we will keep your details on our database, and will contact you when other suitable positions become available.

title: Marketing Co-ordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - Hertfordshire

Hemel Hempstead

£32,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

Some marketing jobs are about keeping the wheels turning. This one gives you the chance to have a say in which direction they should be heading, too.

We're working on a retained basis with an established and growing business that is primarily B2 B with an element of consumer activity. They work with some seriously impressive technology brands and support high-profile customers with specialist equipment and solutions. They're now looking for a Marketing Coordinator who can keep campaigns moving, projects organised and deadlines under control, while also wanting to understand whether all that marketing activity is actually working.

The Role - Marketing Coordinator

You'll take ownership of the marketing plan, coordinating campaigns across different teams, stakeholders and external partners and making sure everyone has what they need to deliver. There will be plenty happening at once, so a big part of the role is keeping activity moving, deadlines on track and the various people involved pointing in roughly the same direction.

But this isn't just a case of ticking things off a marketing calendar. You'll be looking at the numbers too, monitoring KPIs, analysing campaign performance and ROI and working out what landed, what didn't and what could be done better next time. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape future activity. If you spot an opportunity or think something could work better, they'll want to hear it.

Key Responsibilities - Marketing Coordinator
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns and projects.
- Managing marketing plans, calendars, deadlines and activity schedules.
- Working with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively.
- Monitoring campaign performance, engagement and ROI.
- Collating and presenting marketing metrics and performance data.
- Identifying trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
- Supporting the development of longer-term marketing strategy.
- Establishing and monitoring relevant marketing KPIs.
- Preparing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders and brand partners.

About You - Marketing Coordinator

You'll be organised, commercially aware and comfortable taking responsibility for getting things done. There will be multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders competing for your attention, so you'll need to keep on top of the detail without losing sight of why you're doing it in the first place.

You'll also be comfortable with data. You don't need to be someone who dreams about spreadsheets, but you should want to know whether a campaign actually delivered rather than simply being pleased that it went live on time. Strong written communication skills, attention to detail and the confidence to put forward your own ideas will all be important. This is a role with a lot of responsibility, yet also the scope to grow with the business and own the marketing function.

Ideally, you'll have experience of:
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns.
- Using marketing data and analytics to measure performance.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.
- Producing marketing reports and presenting results.
- Supporting wider marketing strategy and planning.
- Working independently and using your initiative to improve marketing activity.

The role is predominantly office-based, although there will be times when you'll visit customers, events and exhibitions, so a full UK driving licence is required. Based in Hemel Hempstead, the office is commutable from St Albans, Watford, Welwyn Garden City, Potters Bar, Luton, Hatfield, Ruislip and Beaconsfield.
